user.title: Budget Thuis Dynamic Prices
user.description: Add Budget Thuis dynamic electricity price sensors. This reads the public tariff page and requires no account or API key. Only one instance is needed per Home Assistant install.

abort.already_configured: Budget Thuis Dynamic Prices is already set up.

init.title: Contract pricing
init.description: Match these to the breakdown shown in the Budget Thuis app under your tariff (beursprijs + inkoopvergoeding + energiebelasting, then BTW). The defaults are a starting point, not guaranteed to match your contract.
